Site.Demo.ChatPanel.Intro: The chat panel of the OnlineChat module; messages and presence arrive through the SignalR hub at /chathub. Preview: text only, 30 messages per minute per user by default, one application instance, no tenant boundary. Open it as a second user to see live updates.
Site.Demo.ChoiceEditors.Intro: Three ways to ask a yes/no or pick-several question, each chosen by an attribute on the C# form property. Press Read Values to see what each one saves.
Site.Demo.ColorEditors.Intro: Both editors store a color as a #rrggbb string, which fits an nvarchar(7) column and works directly in CSS.
Site.Demo.Common.NotStoredThisSampleOnly: Not stored: this sample only shows the request.
Site.Demo.Common.SaveRequestSentToTheSer: Save request sent to the service
Site.Demo.DesignTokens.Intro: Every color, radius and shadow of the theme comes from these custom properties, shown with their live values. A module matches the theme with a Bootstrap fallback, for example var(--bizeka-surface, var(--bs-body-bg)).
Site.Demo.FormDefinitions.Intro: Each dynamic form is one row: a form key, a JSON array of field definitions and an active flag. Dialogs read active definitions through a lookup that holds schemas, never record data. Editing needs DynamicForms:Manage.
Site.Demo.GridFormatters.Intro: Formatters are attached with attributes on a C# columns class, like Serenity's own. The two color formatters read the color from another property of the same row. This grid is filled from memory; with a real service the columns class is the same.
Site.Demo.JsonRoundTrip.Intro: A stored record brings its extra values inside DynamicDataJson; the dialog spreads them into the schema fields and saving packs them again. RetiredField is no longer in the schema, so the next save drops it. Malformed JSON opens with a warning instead of failing.
Site.Demo.JsonRoundTrip.LoadedARecordWho: Loaded a record whose JSON cannot be parsed.
Site.Demo.ModeAndAccent.AnInformationMes: An information message on the current surface.
Site.Demo.ModeAndAccent.Intro: A CSS layer over Serenity's styles, driven by two attributes on the root element and one custom property; Serenity's markup does not change. Pick a mode and an accent, or use the menu in the header that initBizekaTheme adds, then open any other page.
Site.Demo.ModeAndAccent.TheThemeIsRemove: The theme is removed; Serenity's default styles apply. Pick a mode to bring it back.
Site.Demo.NorthwindCustomerFields.Intro: The Northwind customer form with extra fields nobody wrote code for: they come from the definition Northwind.Customer.OpenSource and appear on the Bizeka OSS tab. Change them with Form Design. Northwind has no JSON column, so this sample shows the save request.
Site.Demo.NorthwindCustomerFields.NotSto: Not stored: the request is shown below the form.
Site.Demo.NumberPhoneAndMonth.Intro: Editors for values a plain text box gets wrong: the stepper keeps its range, the phone editor validates (Multiple = true accepts a list) and the month editor saves yyyy-MM. Type an invalid phone number and press Read Values.
Site.Demo.PrioritiesAndStatuses.Intro: Ordinary lookup tables with a color and a sort order, edited with the module's grids. A status marked as completed makes the server fill the task's Completed On date.
Site.Demo.SchemaFields.Intro: JsonDataDialog adds fields described by a schema to an entity dialog. Press Apply Changes: form fields stay top-level, schema fields are collected into the DynamicDataJson string of a JsonDataRow.
Site.Demo.StaticText.Checklist:
1. Describe the change
  2. Name an owner
  3. Pick a date
Site.Demo.StaticText.Instructions: Fill in the request below. Fields marked with an asterisk are required.
Site.Demo.StaticText.Intro: Read-only text between editors: a local text, a short HTML fragment or the value of the field. HTML goes through the corelib sanitizer: the Reviewer note below holds a <script> tag and an onmouseover handler, and neither runs.
Site.Demo.TagsAndSuggestions.Intro: TagListEditor saves a string array, AutoCompleteEditor suggests values but accepts any text, and EmptyLookupEditor is filled from code, for items that depend on another field.
Site.Demo.TaskVisibility.Intro: The real Todo grid. You see a task when you created it, assigned it or are an assignee, and the same rule filters list, retrieve, update and delete on the server (TaskVisibility.CriteriaFor). Try it with two users.
